title: Unemployment Insurance Appeals: Granting Reopening and Setting the Reopened Hearing
content:
**Unemployment Insurance Appeals — reopened hearings.** When the appeals office grants an appellant's timely reopening request on a dismissed appeal, it marks the request granted, sets the reopened hearing by telephone, mails the hearing notice today and notifies every interested party of the docket.

## Where it applies

A reopening request is timely when it is received no later than the docket's reopening window after the mailing date of the dismissal, and the appeal record carries the dismissal's mailing date as its decision mailing date. A dismissed appeal on which the appellant's reopening request is timely is due for the grant of reopening and the setting of its reopened hearing. The grant moves the appeal from dismissed back to scheduled status: reopening of the dismissed appeal is granted and a hearing is set. The result governed here is the reopened hearing date, expressed as the reopened-setting notice period — the whole number of calendar days from today, the day the notice is mailed, to the reopened hearing date.

## Effect on the record

One grant does all of the following:

- the appellant's reopening request is marked **granted**;
- the appeal moves from dismissed to **scheduled** status, and the reopened hearing date is recorded on the appeal as its hearing date;
- a hearing-setting record is entered on the appeal's activity: a telephone hearing at 09:00 local time on the reopened hearing date, notice mailed today, marked as a setting made on reopening;
- the appellant and every interested party see the appeal back on the hearing calendar.

## The tool: `reopen_dismissed_appeal_6a7f532d`

**How it is invoked.** An agent-side tool: the agent unlocks `reopen_dismissed_appeal_6a7f532d` and then calls it.

**Parameters**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `appeal_id` | the docket number of the dismissed appeal, read from the appeal lookup (`find_appeals`) before the call | identifier text |
| `reopening_request_id` | the reference number of the appellant's reopening request on that appeal, read from the appeal request lookup (`find_appeal_requests`) before the call | identifier text |
| `notice_period_days` | the whole number of calendar days from today's date — the notice mailing date, counted as day 0 — to the reopened hearing date | an integer of at least 1; the tool records the hearing date as the YYYY-MM-DD date that many calendar days after today |

**Return.** A text receipt of a dictionary with: `appeal_id` (the docket number), `appeal_event_id` (the reference number of the reopened hearing setting), `reopening_request_id` (the request reference), `request_status` ("granted"), `status` ("scheduled"), `hearing_date` (YYYY-MM-DD), `hearing_time` ("09:00"), `hearing_mode` ("telephone") and `notice_mailed_date` (today's date, YYYY-MM-DD). The call has succeeded when the receipt shows status scheduled, the hearing date and the request status granted.

*Input and receipt (hypothetical):* called on 15 April 2026 with `notice_period_days` 8, the receipt shows `request_status` "granted", `status` "scheduled", `hearing_date` "2026-04-23", `hearing_time` "09:00" and `hearing_mode` "telephone".
